data.name: Fajirah
data.gender_notes: Fajirah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The One Who is the Light of the Dawn. The name Fajirah carries the meaning “Morning Dew” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fajirah usually hope their child will grow to embody morning dew and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who brings light and positivity to the world
data.etymology: Fajirah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Morning Dew.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fajirah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: فاجرة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الإنثى التي تتفوق في الفجر أو الصباح الباكر
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاجرة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي و يعني الإنثى التي تتفوق في الفجر أو الصباح الباكر، ويرتبط بالفجر الذي يعتبر رمزًا للبداية الجديدة والنور بعد الظلام. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الفجر في سورة الفجر، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة روحية ودينية.

in_urdu.name: فاجرہ
in_urdu.meaning: وہ خاتون جو فجر یا صبح سویرے میں شاندار ہو
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاجرہ ایک عربی मूल کا مؤنث نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے وہ خاتون جو فجر یا صبح سویرے میں شاندار ہو۔ یہ نام فجر سے ماخوذ ہے، جو صبح کے اوائل میں طلوع ہونے والا سورج ہے اور نئی شروعات اور امید کا प्रतीک ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں فجر کی نماز کو خاص importance حاصل ہے، جو اس نام کی روحانی اہمیت کو ظاہر کرتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फाजिरा
in_hindi.meaning: वह महिला जो सुबह के समय उत्कृष्ट हो
in_hindi.long_meaning: फाजिरा एक अरबी मूल का स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ है वह महिला जो सुबह के समय उत्कृष्ट हो। यह नाम फज्र से लिया गया है, जो सुबह जल्दी निकलने वाला सूरज है और नई शुरुआत और आशा का प्रतीक है। कुरआन में फज्र का उल्लेख है, विशेष रूप से सूरा फज्र में, जो इस नाम को एक धार्मिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व प्रदान करता है।

in_pashto.name: فاجره
in_pashto.meaning: هغه ښځه چې د سهار په وخت کې غوره وي
in_pashto.long_meaning: فاجره د عربي اصل يو ښځينه نوم دی چې مانا يې هغه ښځه چې د سهار په وخت کې غوره وي. دا نوم د فجر څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې د سهار په پيل کې د ليدنې وړ سورت دی او د نوي پيل او اميد نښه ده. په اسلامي مذهب کې د فجر لمونځ خاصه اهميت لري، کوم چې د دې نوم روحاني اهميت ښيي.

in_english.name: Fajirah
in_english.meaning: A name for a girl who excels at dawn or early morning
in_english.long_meaning: Fajirah is a feminine name of Arabic origin, meaning 'one who excels at dawn' or 'early morning'. The term 'fajr' refers to the dawn prayer in Islam, which holds significant spiritual value. The name symbolizes new beginnings, hope, and enlightenment. It is derived from the Arabic root 'f-j-r', which conveys the idea of breaking or rising, similar to the sun rising at dawn. This name is often chosen for its positive connotations and religious significance in Muslim cultures.

data.cultural_impact: The naming of a child as Fajirah in the Islamic culture reinforces the idea of embracing each day as a new opportunity and emphasizes the importance of the daily transition from darkness to light. This name can inspire individuals to approach each day with positivity, resilience, and a determination to overcome challenges, just as the dawn brings light and clarity after a dark night.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, being named Fajirah can serve as a constant reminder of the role of divine guidance in our lives. The Light of the Dawn symbolizes Allah's illumination that comes our way each day, just as the dawn follows the darkness of the night. The name carries the significance that, just as the Light of the Dawn brings transformation and clarity, so too can Allah's divine guidance illuminate our paths and help us navigate the challenges of life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Morning Dew" symbolizes The One Who is the Light of the Dawn. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Fajirah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of morning dew.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Fajirah bint Mu'awiya was the wife of the Umayyad Caliph Marwan I (685-692 AD). The name Fajirah carried significant weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Fajirah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Maryam Fajirah in Cairo, Egypt attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Fajirah, which means "Morning Dew". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
